name: Example meeting-record list (fixture, not certified data)
source: TASK-022 example fixture. NOT a certified Swiss Athletics/World Athletics record list — marks below are illustrative placeholders. Organizers load their own current, verified record list per meet (domain.ParseRecordList); this file exists only to demonstrate the loadable-data mechanism (ADR-005 §4) and to give the demo/test build something concrete to reference.
notes: meetId values here ("example-meet") are placeholders and will not match any real meet ID (ULIDs are generated at meet creation) — wiring this list to a real meet's meeting record requires editing meetId to that meet's actual ID, or loading an organizer-authored list instead.
